input.quote: 2.1 The Company shall provide all Content to HDI to be included in the Site no later than ten (10) days from the date this Agreement has been executed by both Parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no ownership or intellectual property provision anywhere: it addresses Content delivery (2.1), editorial control (5.2), a limited licence of the Company's Marks to HDI (6.1) and customer e-mail list cross-promotion (7.1), but never states who owns the Site deliverables HDI develops, the Content the Company supplies, or the customer, user and order data generated by the Site. With no clause at all, the rule's preferred and fallback positions are both unmet and the Company's Content, Marks and Site data are left unprotected (and could be claimed by HDI as developer/host). We have inserted a Proprietary Rights section (5.5) confirming Company ownership of Content, Marks and Company Data, assignment of the Site Deliverables to the Company with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and tools under a perpetual, royalty-free licence back to us, and expressly excluding any assignment of Company IP/data to HDI and any joint ownership. Because HDI bears the development costs, the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables in lieu of assignment) is offered in the comment as an acceptable landing zone.

proposal.summary: Add a Proprietary Rights section: Company owns Content, Marks and Site/customer data; HDI assigns Site deliverables while retaining its pre-existing tools with a licence back; no assignment of Company IP/data and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership, so we have added a Proprietary Rights section confirming that we retain our Content, Marks and all Site customer and order data, and that HDI assigns the Site materials developed for us while keeping its own pre-existing platform and tools, licensed to us for continued use. If HDI prefers to retain title to the Site build it funded, we can instead take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those deliverables, but our ownership of the Content and Company Data is not negotiable.

ops.text: 5.5 Proprietary Rights. As between the Parties, the Company owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Content, the Marks and all other materials furnished by the Company under this Agreement, and (ii) all customer, user, order and transaction data collected through or generated by the Site in connection with Deerskin Products (the "Company Data"). HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to the design, look and feel, and other materials and work product developed specifically for the Company or the Site under this Agreement (the "Deliverables"), excluding HDI's pre-existing and generally applicable software, systems, tools and know-how, which HDI retains and in respect of which HDI grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the same to the extent embedded in or reasonably necessary to use the Deliverables. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to HDI any right, title or interest in the Content, the Marks, the Company Data or any other Company intellectual property, and no joint ownership of any of the foregoing is created.
